reason: My guests pay a lot for a week in the villa and they expect me, not a robot, to answer them, even at midnight. I have one property, my kids help with Booking, and Booking already sends the automatic check-in messages, so I don't see what problem this solves for me.
objection: A high-end guest who gets a chatbot instead of the owner feels the place is a factory, and one wrong answer about the pool or the gate code would cost me a review that matters more than €35.
would_change_my_mind: If I could see it working in a villa like mine for a season with good reviews mentioning it, and guests could still reach me directly with one tap whenever they want.
